derived_diagnostics.name: ComBat empirical-Bayes prior diagnostic (figures/combat_prior, tables/combat_prior.csv)
derived_diagnostics.runs_when: --method combat only (the call above: par.prior = TRUE, mean.only = FALSE, ref.batch = NULL); ComBat_seq (shrink = FALSE) and sva/svaseq fit no such prior
derived_diagnostics.reimplements: sva 3.60.0 ComBat(): zero-variance-within-batch rows set aside; design = cbind(model.matrix(~ -1 + batch), mod) without all-one columns; B.hat, grand.mean, var.pooled, stand.mean, s.data; gamma.hat (batch.design regression of s.data); delta.hat = rowVars(s.data[, batch i]) (genefilter, n - 1); gamma.bar = rowMeans(gamma.hat); t2 = rowVars(gamma.hat); a.prior = sva:::aprior = (2 s2 + m^2)/s2; b.prior = sva:::bprior = (m s2 + m^3)/s2
derived_diagnostics.source: deparse(sva::ComBat), deparse(sva:::aprior), deparse(sva:::bprior), deparse(sva:::dinvgamma) in the locked container (acceptance/exemplars/sva-batch/_s4/probe1.log)
derived_diagnostics.prior_grid: 100 points spanning stats::density(<estimates>)$x, as ComBat(prior.plots = TRUE) does; normal density for gamma, inverse gamma b^a/Gamma(a) x^(-a-1) exp(-b/x) for delta evaluated on the log scale
derived_diagnostics.verified_by: tests/run_smoke_test.R A1 F4: equality with ComBat's internals captured by trace(), reproduction of ComBat's adjusted matrix via sva:::it.sol, dinvgamma equality on the grid
